47600.commentary: (JAa) ye phal'atthā'ti ye pakkhino phal'atthāya phalakāraṇā sambhajanti upagacchanti, aphalo'ti ñatvā etaṃ jahanti.

examples.text: manorame āyatane, sevanti naṃ vihaṅ'gamā, chāyaṃ chāy'atthikā yanti, phal'atthā phalabhojino.

47601.meaning1: wanting fruit; in need of fruit

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya phal'atthiko phalagavesī phalapariyesanaṃ caramāno. so taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā taṃ rukkhaṃ passeyya sampannaphalañ'ca upapannaphalañ'ca.

47602.commentary: (ANa) bahiddhā phaladassāvī'ti tassa parehi kataṃ bahiddhā sakkāraphalaṃ passanto.

examples.text: ajjhattañ'ca na jānāti, bahiddhā ca vipassati, bahiddhā phaladassāvī, so'pi ghosena vuyhati.
idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā

47610.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of phalapariyesana
47610.meaning1: looking for fruit; in search of fruit; on a quest for fruit

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya phal'atthiko phalagavesī phalapariyesanaṃ caramāno. so taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā taṃ rukkhaṃ passeyya sampannaphalañ'ca upapannaphalañ'ca.
ujjhāpanakaṃ nāma upasampannaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ sen'āsanapaññāpakaṃ vā bhatt'uddesakaṃ vā yāgubhājakaṃ vā phalabhājakaṃ vā khajjabhājakaṃ vā appamattakavissajjakaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ kattu'kāmo

upasampannassa saṅghena sammatassa sen'āsanapaññāpakassa vā bhatt'uddesakassa vā yāgubhājakassa vā phalabhājakassa vā khajjabhājakassa vā appamattakavissajjakassa vā cīvaraṃ dinne khiyyati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

47613.meaning1: enjoying eating fruit; feeding on fruit

examples.text: manorame āyatane, sevanti naṃ vihaṅ'gamā, chāyaṃ chāy'atthikā yanti, phal'atthā phalabhojino.
ajaraṃ amataṃ amat'ādhigamaṃ, phalamagganidassanaṃ dukkhanudaṃ, sahitattaṃ mah'ārasahassakaraṃ, bhūtam'iti sāraṃ vividhaṃ suṇātha.

47616.meaning1: personal experience of the fruit (of); intimate experience of fruition

examples.text: satt'ime, brāhmaṇa, bojjh'aṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti. katame satta?
uttarimanussadhammo nāma jhānaṃ vimokkho samādhi samāpatti ñāṇadassanaṃ maggabhāvanā phalasacchikiriyā kilesappahānaṃ vinīvaraṇatā cittassa suññ'āgāre abhirati.

47617.meaning2: meditation on the fruit of the path

examples.text: evaṃsīlā'ti maggasīlena phalasīlena lokiyalok'uttarasīlena evaṃsīlā. evaṃdhammā'ti ettha samādhipakkhā dhammā adhippetā, maggasamādhinā phalasamādhinā lokiyalok'uttarasamādhinā, evaṃsamādhayo'ti attho. evaṃpaññā'ti maggapaññ'ādivasen'eva evaṃpaññā.

47621.meaning1: means of knowing the time and the cause for a successful harvest

47622.meaning1: full of fruit; with ripe fruit; laden with fruit

examples.text: sākhāpattaphal'ūpeto, khandhimā'va mahādumo, mūlavā phalasampanno, patiṭṭhā hoti pakkhinaṃ.

47625.meaning1: results and consequences; fruit and outcome
47625.commentary: (THIa) yass'ayaṃ phalavipāko'ti yassa pāpakammassa, ayaṃ sāmikassa amanāpabhāvasaṅkhāto nissandaphalabhūto vipāko.

examples.text: jānāmi attano satta, jātiyo yass'ayaṃ phalavipāko, taṃ tava ācikkhissaṃ, taṃ ekamanā nisāmehi.

maggasammādiṭṭhiyaṃ ṭhitassa maggasammāsaṅkappo pahoti… maggañāṇe ṭhitassa maggavimutti pahoti. tathā phalasammādiṭṭhiyaṃ ṭhitassa phalasammāsaṅkappo pahoti… phalasammāñāṇe ṭhitassa phalavimutti pahotī'ti.

47627.meaning1: difference in the fruit; distinction between results
47627.commentary: (SNa) indriyavemattatā phalavemattatā hotī'ti indriyanānattena phalanānattaṃ, phalanānattena puggalanānattan'ti.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, indriyavemattatā phalavemattatā hoti, phalavemattatā puggalavemattatā'ti.

47628.meaning1: all sorts of fruit; various kinds of fruit

examples.text: anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, khajjake, phal'āphale, uttaribhaṅge, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
tasmiṃ samaye catusattatisahassajaṭilā paṇītapaṇītāni ojavantāni phal'āphalāni gahetvā ācariyassa santikaṃ sampattā buddhānañ'c'eva ācariyassa ca nisinnāsanaṃ oloketvā āhaṃsu.

47630.commentary: (VINa) phal'āsavo nāma muddikaphal'ādīni madditvā tesaṃ rasena kato. (VINt) panas'ādiphalaraso phal'āsavo

examples.text: merayo nāma pupph'āsavo phal'āsavo madhv'āsavo guḷ'āsavo sambhārasaṃyutto.

47632.commentary: (DNa) devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsū'ti devabheriyo phaliṃsu, devo sukkhagajjitaṃ gajji, akālavijjulatā nicchariṃsu, khaṇikavassaṃ vassī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji. ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
catuddisā dundubhiyo, nādayiṃsu amānusā, samantato asaniyo, phaliṃsu ca bhay'āvahā.
kusāvatiyā, ānanda, rājadhāniyā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dvārāni ahesuṃ. ekaṃ dvāraṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ, ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ, ekaṃ veḷuriyamayaṃ, ekaṃ phalikamayaṃ.
cīvaracetāpannaṃ nāma hiraññaṃ vā suvaṇṇaṃ vā muttā vā maṇi vā pavāḷo vā phaliko vā paṭako vā suttaṃ vā kappāso vā.

47634.meaning1: made of crystal; made of quartz crystal

examples.text: kusāvatiyā, ānanda, rājadhāniyā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dvārāni ahesuṃ. ekaṃ dvāraṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ, ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ, ekaṃ veḷuriyamayaṃ, ekaṃ phalikamayaṃ.

47635.commentary: (VINa) pādā'pi phalitā'ti yathā mahācammassa parato maṃsaṃ dissati, evaṃ phālitā, vālikāya vā sakkharāya vā pahaṭamatte dukkhaṃ uppādenti, na sakkā hoti antogāme piṇḍāya carituṃ

examples.text: gilānasamayo nāma antamaso pādā'pi phalitā honti, gilānasamayo'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ.

47636.meaning2: having born fruit, having burst open, having split

examples.text: ajinamhi haññate dīpi, nāgo dantehi haññate, dhanamhi dhanino hanti, aniketam'asanthavaṃ, phalī ambo aphalo ca, te satthāro ubho mama.
pañc'imāni, bhikkhave, bījajātāni. katamāni pañca? mūlabījaṃ, khandhabījaṃ, aggabījaṃ, phalubījaṃ, bījabījaññ'eva pañcamaṃ.

47639.meaning2: metaphorical use of fruit's name for its cause

47640.meaning1: plant which propagates from a joint; joint propagation

examples.text: pañc'imāni, bhikkhave, bījajātāni. katamāni pañca? mūlabījaṃ, khandhabījaṃ, aggabījaṃ, phalubījaṃ, bījabījaññ'eva pañcamaṃ.

47641.commentary: (ANa) catutthe uṭṭhānavīriyen'eva divasaṃ vītināmetvā tassa nissandaphalamattaṃ kiñci'd'eva labhitvā jīvikaṃ kappeti, taṃ pana uṭṭhānaṃ āgamma kiñci puññaphalaṃ nappaṭilabhati, ayaṃ uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī nāma. cātumahārājike pana deve ādiṃ katvā sabbe'pi devā uṭṭhānavīriyena vinā puññaphalass'eva upajīvanato kammaphal'ūpajīvino na uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvino nāma.

examples.text: katame cattāro? uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī, kammaphal'ūpajīvī na uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī, uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī c'eva kammaphal'ūpajīvī ca, n'eva uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

47642.meaning2: having broken; having split; having cut asunder

47644.notes: K.R. Norman suggests on page 213 of 'Buddhism and the Commentarial Tradition' that phalesī is a rare grammatical form, a future active participle, which means 'about to fruit'.

examples.text: ropetva rukkhāni yathā phal'esī, mūle taruṃ chettu tam'eva icchasi, tath'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ karosi, yaṃ maṃ aniccamhi cale niyuñjasi.
aṅgārino dāni dumā bhadante, phal'esino chadanaṃ vippahāya, te accimanto'va pabhāsayanti, samayo mahāvīra bhāgī rasānaṃ.
yo sāsanaṃ arahataṃ, ariyānaṃ dhammajīvinaṃ, paṭikkosati dummedho, diṭṭhiṃ nissāya pāpikaṃ, phalāni kaṭṭhakass'eva, attaghātāya phallati.

47646.meaning1: sense contact; sense impingement; sense impression; sense experience

examples.text: kabaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ
phassanidānaṃ sātaṃ asātaṃ, phasse asante na bhavanti h'ete, vibhavaṃ bhavañ'c'āpi yam'etam'atthaṃ, etaṃ te pabrūmi itonidānaṃ.

47647.commentary: (THa) ito c'ito ca āvaṭṭanto vivaṭṭanto virodhento vedhati phassaphuṭṭho'ti dhīro pana paṇḍito dukkhasamphassena samphuṭṭho na vedhati kampanamattam'pi tassa na hotī'ti.

examples.text: aḍḍhā daliddā ca phusanti phassaṃ, bālo ca dhīro ca tath'eva phuṭṭho, bālo ca bālyā vadhito'va seti, dhīro ca na vedhati phassaphuṭṭho.

47648.meaning1: classes of sense contact; categories of sense impression

examples.text: cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā, chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā
katamo ca, bhikkhave, phasso? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phassakāyā, cakkhusamphasso, sotasamphasso, ghānasamphasso, jivhāsamphasso, kāyasamphasso, manosamphasso. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, phasso.

47649.meaning1: produced by sense contact; caused by sense impingement

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, imā tisso vedanā phassajā phassamūlakā phassanidānā phassapaccayā. tajjaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca tajjā vedanā uppajjanti.
vedanā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? vedanā phassanidānā phassasamudayā phassajātikā phassapabhavā.

47652.meaning1: pair of experiences; pair of sense impressions
47652.commentary: (SNa) phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe'ti sukhaphassañ'ca dukkhaphassañ'cā'ti idaṃ phassadvayaṃ upekkhe, upekkhā'm'ev'ettha uppādeyyā'ti attho. phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ upekkho'ti vā pāṭho, phassahetukaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ upekkho, sukhe anurodhaṃ dukkhe ca virodhaṃ anuppādento upekkhako bhaveyyā'ti'pi attho.

examples.text: phassena phuṭṭho na sukhena majje, dukkhena phuṭṭho'pi na sampavedhe, phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe, anānuruddho aviruddha kenaci.

47655.meaning1: diversity of sense contacts; variety of sense impingements
47655.commentary: (DNa) phassanānattaṃ paṭiccā'ti cakkhusamphass'ādi-nānattaṃ paṭicca. (SNa) uppajjati phassanānattan'ti nānāsabhāvo phasso uppajjati. tattha cakkhusamphass'ādayo cakkhuviññāṇ'ādisampayuttā, manosamphasso manodvāre paṭhamajavanasampayutto, tasmā.

examples.text: katame nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? nava nānattā, dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṃ, vedanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññānānattaṃ, saññānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṃ, saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṃ
dhātunānattaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ. katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dhātunānattaṃ?

47656.meaningLit: discourse on diversity of sense experiences

47657.commentary: (NIDD1) phassanidānaṃ sātaṃ asātan'ti. sāt'āsātā phassanidānā phassasamudayā phassajātikā phassappabhavāti, phassanidānaṃ sātaṃ asātaṃ.

examples.text: vedanā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? vedanā phassanidānā phassasamudayā phassajātikā phassapabhavā.

47658.meaning1: ending of sense contact; cessation of sense experience

examples.text: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.
phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayo, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho.

47659.meaning1: leading to the ending of sense contact; leading to the cessation of sense experience

examples.text: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako phassañ'ca pajānāti, phassasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, phassanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, phassanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

47660.meaning1: dependent on sense contact; caused by sense impingement

47661.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of phassapaccaya
47661.meaning1: dependent on sense contact; due to sense impingement

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ phassapaccayā
avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā

47662.meaning1: section on dependence on sense contact

47664.meaning1: (of the components of nāma) with sense contact as the fifth

examples.text: tato tadārammaṇe phassapañcamake nāman'ti evaṃ nāmarūpaṃ pariggahetvā tassa paccayaṃ pariyesanto avijj'ādipaṭiccasamuppādaṃ disvā paccaya-paccay'uppanna-dhammamattam'ev'etaṃ, añño satto vā puggalo vā n'atthī'ti

47665.meaning1: concept of sense contact; what is called sense impingement
47665.commentary: (MNa) phassapaññattiṃ paññapessatī'ti phasso nāma eko dhammo uppajjatī'ti evaṃ phassapaññattiṃ paññapessati, dassessatī'ti attho. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: so vat'āvuso, cakkhusmiṃ sati rūpe sati cakkhuviññāṇe sati phassapaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati. phassapaññattiyā sati vedanāpaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.

47666.meaning1: produced by sense contact; generated by experience

examples.text: vedanā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? vedanā phassanidānā phassasamudayā phassajātikā phassapabhavā.

47667.meaning1: overwhelmed by sense contact; afflicted by sense impressions

examples.text: tesaṃ phassaparetānaṃ, bhavasot'ānusārinaṃ, kummaggapaṭipannānaṃ, ārā saṃyojanakkhayo.

47668.meaning1: contacted by sense contact; experiencing the touch
47668.commentary: (THa) vedhati phassaphuṭṭho'ti dhīro pana paṇḍito dukkhasamphassena samphuṭṭho na vedhati kampanamattam'pi tassa na hotī'ti.

examples.text: aḍḍhā daliddā ca phusanti phassaṃ, bālo ca dhīro ca tath'eva phuṭṭho, bālo ca bālyā vadhito'va seti, dhīro ca na vedhati phassaphuṭṭho.

47669.meaning1: rooted in sense contact; stemming from sense impingement

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, imā tisso vedanā phassajā phassamūlakā phassanidānā phassapaccayā. tajjaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca tajjā vedanā uppajjanti.

47671.meaning1: source of sense contact; arising of sense experience
47671.commentary: (MNa) phassasamudayā'ti ettha pana pañcadvāre pañcavatthukavedanānaṃ sahajāta-cakkhusamphass'ādi-samudayā samudayo hoti. avasesānaṃ cakkhusamphass'ādayo upanissay'ādi-vasena paccayā. manodvāre tadārammaṇavedanānaṃ advārikānañ'ca paṭisandhi-bhav'aṅga-cuti-vedanānaṃ sahajātamanosamphassasamudayā samudayo hotī'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.
phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayo, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho.

47672.meaning1: with sense contact as source; originating from sense experience
47672.commentary: (MNa) phassasamudayā'ti ettha pana pañcadvāre pañcavatthukavedanānaṃ sahajāta-cakkhusamphass'ādi-samudayā samudayo hoti. avasesānaṃ cakkhusamphass'ādayo upanissay'ādi-vasena paccayā. manodvāre tadārammaṇavedanānaṃ advārikānañ'ca paṭisandhi-bhav'aṅga-cuti-vedanānaṃ sahajātamanosamphassasamudayā samudayo hotī'ti veditabbo. (ANa) phassasamudayo'ti phasso samudayo assā'ti phassasamudayo, imasmiṃ attabhāve katakammaphassapaccayā nibbatto anāgatattabhāvo. (ANa) phassato samudenti rāsī bhavantī'ti phassasamudayā. (NIDD1a) phassasamudayo'ti vatth'ārammaṇo. yato samudeti uppajjati, so samudayo.

examples.text: te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamudayā'ti? phassasamudayā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamosaraṇā'ti? vedanāsamosaraṇā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃpamukhā'ti? samādhippamukhā, bhante'ti.
chandamūlakā, āvuso, sabbe dhammā, manasikārasambhavā sabbe dhammā, phassasamudayā sabbe dhammā, vedanāsamosaraṇā sabbe dhammā

47673.meaning1: produced by sense contact; generated by touch

examples.text: tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā phassasambhavā, abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittam'ass'ūpahaññati, evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbānam'uccati.

47675.meaning1: complete comprehension of contact; total understanding of experience

examples.text: ye ca phassaṃ pariññāya, aññāy'upasame ratā, te ve phass'ābhisamayā, nicchātā parinibbutā'ti.

47676.meaning1: with sense fields; having (six) fields of sense impression

examples.text: cha dhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso cha phass'āyatano aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicāro catur'ādhiṭṭhāno, yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccati.

cha phass'āyatano ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkhusamphass'āyatanaṃ, sotasamphass'āyatanaṃ, ghānasamphass'āyatanaṃ, jivhāsamphass'āyatanaṃ, kāyasamphass'āyatanaṃ, manosamphass'āyatanaṃ.

47677.meaning1: sense field; field of experience; field of sense impression

examples.text: evam'eva kho, āvuso, bhikkhu chassu phass'āyatanesu n'eva attānaṃ n'āttaniyaṃ samanupassati.
sati kāyagatā upaṭṭhitā, chasu phass'āyatanesu saṃvuto, satataṃ bhikkhu samāhito, jaññā nibbānam'attano'ti.

47678.meaning1: sustenance that is sense experience; nutriment of sense impingement
47678.commentary: (SNt) yattakā phassassa pakārabhedā, tesaṃ vasena sabbappakāro'pi phass'āhāro yath'ārahaṃ tisso vedanā āharati, anāhārako n'atthi.

examples.text: yaṃ yadeva hi sā, bhikkhave, gāvī niccammā nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye tan'nissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ. evam'eva khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, phass'āhāro daṭṭhabbo'ti vadāmi. phasse, bhikkhave, āhāre pariññāte tisso vedanā pariññātā honti.
mayhañ'ca kho etaṃ bhante ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya

47680.meaning1: having reached; having attained; having experienced
47680.synonym: anupāpuṇitvā, upagantvā, pāpuṇitvā, pāpuṇitvāna, phassayitvā, phusayitvā, phussayitvā

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo ubhatobhāgavimutto? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te kāyena phassitvā viharati paññāya c'assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.
theyyaṃ na kāre na musā bhaṇeyya, mettāya phasse tasathāvarāni, yadāvilattaṃ manaso vijaññā, kaṇhassa pakkho'ti vinodayeyya.
phaḷubījaṃ nāma, ucchu, veḷu, naḷo, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi pabbe jāyanti, pabbe sañjāyanti, etaṃ phaḷubījaṃ nāma.

47686.meaning1: plant which propagates from a joint; joint propagation

examples.text: phaḷubījaṃ nāma, ucchu, veḷu, naḷo, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi pabbe jāyanti, pabbe sañjāyanti, etaṃ phaḷubījaṃ nāma.

47687.commentary: (VIN 1.4.3.3) phāṇitaṃ nāma ucchumhā nibbattaṃ. (VINa) phāṇitaṃ nāma ucchumhā nibbattan'ti ucchurasaṃ upādāya apakkā vā avatthukapakkā vā sabbā'pi avatthukā ucchuvikati phāṇitan'ti veditabbā.
47687.notes: (MW) the inspissated juice of the sugar cane and other plants

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhesajjāni, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā satt'āhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

examples.text: ekādasahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikattuṃ. katamehi ekādasahi?

47692.synonym: aparabhāva, phāti, bhiyyobhāva, vaḍḍhi, vinibbaya, viruḷhi, virūḷhi, vuddhi
47692.commentary: (VINa) phātikamm'atthāyā'ti vaḍḍhikammatthāya. phātikammañ'c'ettha samakaṃ vā atirekaṃ vā agghanakaṃ mañcapīṭh'ādi-sen'āsanam'eva vaṭṭati.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, phātikamm'atthāya parivattetun'ti.

sace paṭippassaddhāya katikāya sāmaṇerā n'eva rukkhato pātenti, na bhūmito gahetvā bhikkhūnaṃ denti, patitaphalāni pādehi paharantā vicaranti, tesaṃ dasabhāgato paṭṭhāya yāva upaḍḍhaphalabhāgena phātikammaṃ kātabbaṃ.

katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo andho? idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātikareyya, tathārūpam'pi'ssa cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusal'ākusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajj'ānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnappaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya.

47694.grammar: inf of phātiṃ karoti, comp vb

47695.commentary: (ANa) na phātiseyyan'ti seyyā'pi'ssa na hoti vuḍḍhi, tassa mahantaṃ vīhithambhasannivesaṃ na hotī'ti attho.
